name: Widget

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the shared widget, which can be used to send the widget again using the method sendSharedWidget; omitted if the widget isn't shared

fields.name: width
fields.description: Width of the widget in logical pixels; omitted if the widget must occupy the whole width of the message bubble

fields.name: height
fields.description: Height of the widget in logical pixels; omitted if the height of the widget isn't fixed

fields.name: public_data
fields.description: Public data of the widget, which is available wherever the widget is shown. All messages with a shared widget have the same public data.

fields.name: chat_data
fields.description: Data of the widget, which is specific to the message

description: This object describes an HTML widget.
